correctness.rationale: The domain contains exactly 64 binary words. Adjacent transpositions preserve Hamming weight, making different layers automatically compatible. For each layer, the verifier exhaustively enumerates every subset at the claimed maximum size and every subset one larger, so the layer maxima and numbers of equality cases are exhaustive. A separately constructed token-graph distance table agrees with direct error-ball intersection on every same-weight pair. All 7056 cross-layer products are then checked against the original channel definition, and the stated four-element symmetry action is evaluated on every maximum.

value.rationale: The 1tc.64 instance is a longstanding exact coding/independent-set benchmark. Knowing only that the optimum is 20 leaves the equality structure undetermined. The complete census reveals a natural rigidity/freedom split: the weight-three component is unique, while weights one, two, four, and five supply all multiplicity. The exact labeled count and symmetry-reduced orbit census are therefore motivated finite invariants and provide reproducible reference data for algorithms on adjacent-transposition codes and token-graph packings.
